name: Caitlin
source: Caitlin often quarrels with her teacher and family over her appearance, but she does not change her style. She has a younger sister, whom, according to her parents, she sets a bad example for. She likes expensive cigarettes and heavy music. She can't always get the first one, so bring her her favorite brand and she'll thank you awkwardly.
